channel.title: Eastern Daily Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Eastern Daily Press (edp24.co.uk)

item.title: Meet the team behind Norwich's newest fine-dining restaurant
item.description: Blossom, a fine-dining restaurant, is opening on December 5 in the former Roger Hickman's in Norwich's Upper St Giles Street.

item.title: Labour 'running scared of voters' as it delays vote for Norfolk-Suffolk mayor to 2028
item.description: Politicians from across the political spectrum have been left furious after it emerged the Norfolk and Suffolk mayoral elections will be postponed for two years.

item.title: Norfolk costume designer who styles a-list celebrities takes home top prize
item.description: A costume designer who grew up in Norfolk has won her second big industry award.

item.title: Man arrested over early hours violence on Norwich street
item.description: A man has been arrested following a fight on Rose Lane in Norwich during the early hours of this morning.

item.title: 100mph crash driver jailed after seriously injuring passenger
item.description: A driver who began overtaking vehicles and accelerating up to speeds of 100mph on the A10 and A1101 has been jailed.

item.title: Northern lights return to Norfolk skies... to the delight of photographers
item.description: Stunning photos show the northern lights over Norfolk last night.

item.title: Row over photo of victim's 'daughter' led to fatal Norwich stabbing
item.description: A former soldier accused of murder said he stabbed his friend following a row in the belief his neighbour was coming at him with a tool in his hand, Norwich Crown Court has heard.

item.title: Fancy a job at a nuclear power plant? - then this job fair is for you
item.description: It is a once-in-a-generation development on the Suffolk coast that is set to power up the region.

item.title: Norwich firm scoops double award at EDP Business Awards
item.description: Tax consultancy Wilby Jones in Norwich has been named the winner of the Employer of the Year and the Growth Business of the Year awards at the EDP Business Awards 2025.

item.title: Council digs its heels in over bus shelter and orders protesters to move on
item.description: A council has dug its heels in and refusing to back down over controversial plans to bulldoze a bus shelter despite protestors' pleas.
